verses.gurmukhi: ਸਜਾ ਖਬਾ ਸਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sajaa khabaa saun na ma(n)n vasaiaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs never take to their heart the omen on the right or the left.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਪੈਰੁ ਹਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: naar purakh no vekh na pair haTaiaa|

en.bdb: They do not retrace their steps while seeing a man or woman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਖ ਸੁਭਾਖ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਛਿਕ ਮਨਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaakh subhaakh veechaar na chhik manaiaa|

en.bdb: They do not pay attention to the crises of animals or sneezing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev na sev na pooj karaiaa|

en.bdb: Goddess and gods are neither served nor worshipped by them.
By not entangling in deceits, they do not allow their minds to wander.
The Gursikhs have sowed the seed of truth in the field of life and have made it fruitful.
